# Simulated-writes baseline — see docs/audit/ADMIN_SIMULATED_WRITES.md
#
# Each line is a mutation whose fixture branch returns a success value: the
# operator is told the action succeeded while nothing happens server-side. These
# PREDATE the guard, which fails only on ADDITIONS — so this list can shrink but
# never grow.
#
# To clear an entry: point the function at a real endpoint, or make it throw so
# the control fails honestly, then delete the line. CI reports baselined entries
# that have been fixed.
#
